lines.name: Jenny
lines.en: Hey, Hyunju! Long time no see! What did you do yesterday?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: I went to an exhibition by Do Ho Suh. It was really good.
lines.ko: 서도호 작가 전시회에 갔어. 정말 좋았어.

lines.name: Jenny
lines.en: Oh, Do Ho Suh! I've heard of him. He makes those big fabric houses, right? What did you like the most?
lines.ko: 아, 서도호! 들어 봤어. 천으로 커다란 집 만드는 작가 맞지? 뭐가 제일 좋았어?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: I like his early drawings. They are so cute and full of humor.
lines.ko: 초기 드로잉이 좋아. 너무 귀엽고 유머가 넘쳐.

lines.name: Jenny
lines.en: Really? I didn't know he drew cute drawings! What kind of drawings were they?
lines.ko: 정말? 귀여운 그림도 그리는 줄 몰랐어! 어떤 그림이었어?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: They are about houses and people. That is the theme of the exhibition.
lines.ko: 집과 사람에 관한 그림이야. 그게 전시 주제야.

lines.name: Jenny
lines.en: Houses and people... That sounds interesting! Did you go with someone, or did you go alone?
lines.ko: 집과 사람이라… 재밌겠다! 누구랑 갔어, 아니면 혼자 갔어?

lines.name: Jenny
lines.en: Oh, alone? That's nice. You can take your time and enjoy the art. Was it crowded?
lines.ko: 혼자? 좋네. 천천히 작품을 즐길 수 있잖아. 사람 많았어?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: It was free because of the Chuseok holiday, so it was crowded.
lines.ko: 추석 연휴라서 무료였거든. 그래서 사람이 많았어.

lines.name: Jenny
lines.en: Oh, it was free during Chuseok? Lucky you! But I guess there were a lot of people. How long did you stay there?
lines.ko: 추석에 무료였어? 운 좋았네! 그래도 사람 많았겠다. 얼마나 있었어?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: I stayed for about an hour, and I bought a magnet as a souvenir.
lines.ko: 한 시간쯤 있었고, 기념으로 마그넷을 샀어.

lines.name: Jenny
lines.en: A magnet! That's a nice souvenir. Would you recommend the exhibition to me?
lines.ko: 마그넷! 좋은 기념품이네. 나한테도 추천할 만해?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: I highly recommend it! It was really good. I'd like to go again.
lines.ko: 완전 추천해! 정말 좋았어. 또 가고 싶어.

lines.name: Jenny
lines.en: Wow, you really loved it! Then let's go together next time.
lines.ko: 와, 진짜 좋았나 보다! 그럼 다음에 같이 가자.

vocab.example: I went to an exhibition by Do Ho Suh.
They are so cute and full of humor.
That is the theme of the exhibition.
It was free, so it was crowded.
I bought a magnet as a souvenir.
It was free because of the Chuseok holiday.
